newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end weaker, new lows hit across board.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end weaker, new lows hit across board.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures settled a heavily-traded session sharply weaker, with the spot-January contract closing below support at 90.00 cents a lb, and several of the back months ending down the daily 5.00-cent limit.
Fresh life-of-contract lows were set across the board with prices coming up from those levels just barely by the close.

Analysts said Friday's options expiry initiated losses, as 9,652 puts were exercised today. A dearth of buying interest added pressure while fund, commission house, and trade selling took out stops on the way dwon, they said.
January juice ended down 6.05 to 89.00, cents per pound, traded 94.60 to 88.25 cents, a life-of-contract low. The back months finished 5.00 and 4.75 lower.
Open interest in January remains high at 11,321 lots, as of Friday.
While the near-term fundamental picture remains bleak, market sources hope the impending winter and marketing promotions planned for the New Year, spark interest.
